transcript.statement: The Trustworthiness dimension is critical for ensuring the security and privacy of student attendance data. TRU-01 ensures data is encrypted, safeguarding it from unauthorized access. TRU-02 implements role-based access control to restrict user access, enhancing security. TRU-03 maintains an audit log for accountability and traceability. TRU-04 ensures that students can only view their data post-authentication, protecting privacy. TRU-05 verifies data integrity through checksums, and TRU-06 allows users to report breaches, fostering trust. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to prevent unauthorized access due to inactivity. These requirements collectively establish a robust framework for protecting sensitive data.

transcript.statement: The Sustainability dimension is vital for minimizing the environmental impact of the RollCall system. GRN-01 aims to reduce energy consumption by utilizing efficient algorithms, while GRN-02 emphasizes cloud storage in energy-efficient data centers. GRN-03 focuses on low-energy communication for real-time updates, and GRN-04 promotes resource-efficient report formats. GRN-05 raises awareness of carbon footprints, supporting eco-conscious behavior. GRN-06 ensures data retention policies align with sustainability, and GRN-07 optimizes the user interface for low-power devices. Together, these requirements help create a more sustainable product that considers its ecological footprint.

transcript.statement: The Responsibility dimension is essential for ensuring ethical handling of student attendance data. RES-01 guarantees compliance with data protection regulations like GDPR, protecting student privacy. RES-02 enhances transparency by logging attendance changes, fostering accountability. RES-03 allows students to dispute records, ensuring fairness. RES-04 mandates anonymization in reports to safeguard identities, while RES-05 notifies students promptly about their attendance status, promoting engagement. RES-06 and RES-07 ensure that only authorized personnel access data and maintain historical records for compliance. Together, these requirements uphold social responsibility and accountability.

transcript.statement: The Efficiency dimension is crucial for ensuring the RollCall system operates smoothly and responsively. EFF-01 ensures real-time data processing within 2 seconds, which is vital for prompt attendance updates. EFF-02 guarantees support for up to 500 concurrent users, preventing system overload. EFF-03 ensures that reports are generated within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students, enhancing administrative efficiency. EFF-04 complements the need for historical data retention while optimizing for storage. EFF-05 guarantees students can view their records in under 3 seconds, promoting engagement. EFF-06 implements load balancing for optimal resource use, and EFF-07 ensures a quick user interface, maximizing user satisfaction.

transcript.statement: The Safety and Reliability dimension is crucial for ensuring that the RollCall system operates securely and accurately. SAF-01 focuses on secure user authentication to prevent unauthorized access, while SAF-02 ensures real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate records. SAF-03 implements automated alerts for discrepancies, enhancing data accuracy. SAF-04 mandates storing historical attendance data for five years for long-term analysis. SAF-05 provides logging for attendance modifications, ensuring accountability. SAF-06 allows manual overrides during errors, enhancing fault tolerance. Finally, SAF-07 requires regular security audits to mitigate vulnerabilities. Together, these requirements form a robust framework for safety and reliability.

The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years with performance-optimized and ethical storage practices.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and processing to ensure accurate attendance records.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records after successful authentication.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed within 2 seconds of input to enhance efficiency.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to interactions within 1 second.
The system shall implement energy-efficient storage solutions for historical data management.
